messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Bug tracking system for ggplo2
parts:
> The reply to this email is potentially of interest to other people on this
> list:
>
> How do you prefer ggplot2 bugs to be reported:
>  - email to you
>  - email to ggplot2@googlegroups
>  - bug tracking system at github: http://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/issues

Currently either of the first two options is fine, although the second
is to be slightly preferred as someone other than me might be able to
tell you it's not actually a bug, or suggest a workaround.

I have been thinking about using the github issue tracking to make it
easier to communicate the results of a bug fix to the person who
reported it, but I haven't started yet.

Hadley
